problem_understanding.task_summary: Multi-label classification of seven steel plate defect categories from tabular manufacturing features, predicting defect probabilities for each category.
risks: Class distribution across the seven defect labels is not summarized in the provided metadata; label imbalance should be checked before modeling.
Evaluation is macro-averaged ROC AUC across seven labels, so weaker or rare-label performance can disproportionately reduce the score.
The dataset is synthetically generated for a Kaggle Playground competition and may contain generation artifacts.
problem_understanding.business_goal_summary: Predict the probability of each steel plate defect type to support manufacturing quality control and inspection prioritization. The output should be interpretable and translatable into business-facing defect risk signals for the seven categories.
